# libgit2

Turtle Code links the system libgit2 (>= 1.1) via pkg-config; no library sources
or binaries are vendored. Tested with 1.9.7. Upstream: https://libgit2.org/ .

COPYING is the upstream GPL v2 license with linking exception, copied from
the installed libgit2 1.9.7 package. The linking exception permits linking
and distributing combinations with other programs; see COPYING for full terms.
